bill.name: Food import bill
bill.note: Denominator is merchandise exports only, so tourism and remittance economies read far worse than they are.

gdp.name: GDP per capita
gdp.note: Carried as the guard on the food import bill, whose denominator fails for service economies.

accessgap.name: Inequality of food access
accessgap.note: The only indicator here that sees inside a country. National earnings cannot: Gabon runs a small food bill on high GDP per head and still has 20% undernourishment.

cerealdep.name: Cereal import dependency
cerealdep.note: FAO's own figure, kept as a cross-check on the per-crop reliance this app computes from FBS.

cerealshare.name: Dietary energy from cereals, roots and tubers

undernourished.name: Prevalence of undernourishment
undernourished.note: Outcome only. Never an input to placement.
